_comment: Per-PR demo for #1348 / #1178 line_relief corridor: back ranks widen so the reliever can pass between without intra-unit overlap.
caption: Line relief corridor (#1178 / #1348): a fresh Infantry behind the line relieves a tired engaged ally. Watch the tired unit's back ranks widen to open a centre lane as the reliever advances through — no defect_exemptions; formation-slot physics keeps soldiers from overlapping during the peel-back.
